text: We looked at 300 leak repairs drawn at random from Zulal's 12,000 repairs of the year. The median repair took 6.2 hours; the middle half took between 3.7 and 10.4 hours. 1 ticket in the sample was closed in the system weeks late and is reported separately; the longest regular repair took 42.8 hours. These numbers describe the 300 sampled repairs, by contractor and never by household.
